en.title: Amtrak Modernizes Fleet with Accessibility Upgrades, Boosting Disabled Travel
en.summary: Amtrak announced fleet modernization incorporating wheelchair ramps, priority seating, tactile signage, and audio description services to improve accessibility for disabled passengers. Meanwhile, McDowell launched initiatives to improve accessibility across Wyoming, and a disability rights campaign in Kobe marked the 10th anniversary of the Sagamihara stabbing with anti-discrimination outreach. Research shows that 85% of students using accessibility tools do not have documented disabilities, highlighting universal design benefits, while AI innovations are boosting independence for people with developmental disabilities.

zh-TW.title: Amtrak升級無障礙車隊，提升殘障旅客體驗
zh-TW.summary: Amtrak 宣布艦隊現代化計畫，加裝輪椅坡道、優先座位、觸覺標誌及音訊描述服務，以提升殘障乘客的無障礙旅行體驗。同時，McDowell 推動懷俄明州無障礙設施改善，神戶反歧視運動紀念相模原事件十週年，喚起社會關注。研究顯示 85% 使用無障礙工具的學生並無殘障證明，凸顯普惠設計的價值；AI 則協助發展障礙者提升獨立生活能力。
